assumptions.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will pay USD 100 for a digital template pack that helps them track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Create a landing page with a call-to-action to purchase the template pack and track the number of sign-ups or pre-orders within a week.

assumptions.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will use the template pack to track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Offer a free version of the template pack to a small group of designers and ask them to provide feedback on its usefulness within a week.

assumptions.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will prefer a bilingual (Arabic and English) template pack over a single-language one.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Create two versions of the template pack—one in Arabic and one in English—and ask a sample of designers to rate their preference for each version.

assumptions.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will not collect client data through the template pack.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Include a privacy policy in the template pack and ask a sample of designers to confirm they understand and agree with the privacy policy.

assumptions.text: The founder has the skills to build a bilingual template pack using Notion and Google Sheets.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Ask a sample of designers to review the template pack and provide feedback on its usability and functionality.

assumptions.text: The budget of USD 100 is sufficient for initial development and testing.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Track the actual costs of development and testing and compare them to the budget.

assumptions.text: Competitors offer free or low-cost alternatives that may undermine the value proposition of the paid template pack.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Compare the features and pricing of free or low-cost alternatives to the paid template pack.
